=== registers by name
	.text
f:
	.cfi_startproc
	pushl %ebp
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 8
	.cfi_offset %ebp, -8
	movl %esp, %ebp
	.cfi_def_cfa_register %ebp
	pushl %ebx
	.cfi_offset ebx, -12
	.cfi_offset %xmm7, -16
	.cfi_offset %st(3), -20
	.cfi_offset %mm0, -24
	.cfi_register %eip, %eax
	.cfi_same_value %eflags
	.cfi_undefined %es, %gs, %mxcsr
	popl %ebx
	.cfi_restore %ebx
	popl %ebp
	.cfi_def_cfa %esp, 4
	ret
	.cfi_endproc
=== a frame in .debug_frame too
	.cfi_sections .eh_frame, .debug_frame
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
	.globl f
f:
	.loc 1 3 0
	.cfi_startproc
	pushl %ebx
	.cfi_adjust_cfa_offset 4
	.cfi_rel_offset %ebx, 0
	.loc 1 4 5 prologue_end
	movl 8(%esp), %eax
	.loc 1 5 1 epilogue_begin
	popl %ebx
	.cfi_adjust_cfa_offset -4
	.cfi_restore %ebx
	ret
	.cfi_endproc
